title: Story vs Telling Part 2
summary: Kahran and Divya continue the storytelling series, this time wrestling with Divya's story — and the gap between having a story and telling it well. They open with sacred vs secular spaces (Naoshima, Lotus Temple, a poet's cemetery in Colorado), then move into Divya's multidisciplinary practice as an artist/VFX-producer/game-designer and the challenge of compressing a multifaceted self into a 2D projection for an audience.

intents.display: to think about the gap between having a story and telling it well
to hear an artist talk about a multidisciplinary practice that resists summary
